simple.meaning: נוּף (nûwph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to quiver (i.e. vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 37 times across Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 6 more, beginning at Exodus 20:25. Its contexts include family line, offering, altar.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נוּף (H5130).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נוּף (nûwph) / H5130 is traced through Exodus 20:25, Exodus 29:24, Exodus 29:26, Exodus 29:27 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H5130. nuph I. [ נוּף ] verb move to and fro, wave, besprinkle (Late Hebrew Hiph`il, Pilpal wave, blow, fan , compare נָפָה sift , נָפָה noun sieve (as Biblical Hebrew); ᵑ7 Aph`el as Biblical Hebrew; Syriac bend, wave, shake ; Di compare Ethiopic quadril. distil, drop like dew ; sift ); — Qal Perfect 1singular וגו מֹר מִשְׁכָּבִי ׳נַ֫פְתִּי Prov 7:17 I have besprinkled my couch with myrrh , etc. Po`lel Imperfect 3masculine singular וגו הַר יָדוֺ ׳יְנֹפֵף Isa 10:32 he brandisheth his hand toward the mountain (on accusative הַר compare Ges § 118f . Da Synt. § 69, R 2 ). Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular הֵנִיף Josh 8:31 +, 2 masculine singular הֵנַ֫פְתָּ Exod 20:25 (Ges § 72k ), וְהֵנַפְתָּ֫ 29:24 3 t.; 1 singular הֲנִיפֹ֫תִי Job 31:21 ; Imperfect וַיָּ֫נֶף Lev 8:27 ; Num 8:21 , suffix וַיְנִיפֵ֫הוּ Lev 8:29 ; 2 masculine singular תָּנִיף Deuteronomy 23:26 2 t., etc.; Imperative masculine plural הָנִ֫יפוּ Isa 13:2 ; Infinitive construct הָנִיף 10:15 2 t.; לַהֲנָפָה 30:28 (Ges § 72z Ba NB 90 , see also הֲנָחָה ), etc.; Participle מֵנִיף 19:16 ; Zech 2:13 , etc.; — swing, wield, wave: — 1 wield , move tool to and fro in using it, with עַלֿ of material: עָלֶיהָ הֵנַפְתָּ חֵרְבְּךָ כִּי Exod 20:25 (E), i.e. over stone, so Deut 27:5 ; Josh 8:31 (D), and Deuteronomy 23:26 a sickle thou shalt not wield over the standing grain of thy neighbour; absolute מְנִיפוֺ Isa 10:15 against him that wieldeth it (i.e. a saw), and וְאֶתמְֿרִימוֺ שֵׁבֶט כְּהָנִיף 10:15 (read אֶתֿ ) like a rod's wielding him that lifteth it .2. Shake or wave the hand; a. wave hand אֶלהַֿמָּקוֺם 2Kin 5:11 , in healing ceremony (i.e. probably toward sanctuary Kmp Kau ; > toward the spot [where leprosy appears], so most). b. with עַלֿ , shake or brandish against , Isa 11:15 ; 19:16 ; Zech 2:13 (all of ׳י ) Job 31:21 [compare Ecclus 12:18 (without עַל ) in mockery]. c. wave hand, as a signal, Isa 13:2 . 3 swing to and fro בְּנָפַת , in a sieve , Isa 30:28 (figurative, of nations). 4 Oft. technical term in P (H), of rite in which originally the priest lifted his share of offering and waved it, i.e. moved it toward altar and back, in token of its presentation to God and its return by him to priest: in H, י לִפְנֵי אֶתהָֿעֹמֶר ׳וְהֵנִיף Lev 23:11 a compare 23:11 b; 23:12 , also 23:20 (on text see Di Dr-Wh Hpt ); in P, י לִפְנֵי ׳תְּנוּפָה אֹתוֺ וְהֵנַפְתָּ֫ Exod 29:26 , so Lev 7:30 ; 8:29 ; 10:15 (object omitted) Num 6:20 ; thus also Levites are set apart for service of the priests 8:11 (Di strike out see ), 8:13 ; 8:21 , compare 8:14 ( י ׳לִפְנֵי omitted); but same phr, of entire lamb, with oil, Lev 14:12 , 24 , and of offerings which were burnt, entirely Exod 29:24 (compare 29:25 ), Lev 8:27 (compare 8:28 ), or in part Num 5:25 ( י לִפְנֵי הַמִּנְחָה ׳הֵנִיף ), — in these the original significance seems lost; so, clearly, of contributions for tabernacle, = offer לְי זָהָב תְּנוּפַת ׳הֵנִיף Exod 35:22 . — compare תְּנוּפָה below 5 Shed abroad (si vera lectio) תָּנִיף נְדָבוֺת גֶּשֶׁם Psa 68:10 bounteous rain thou didst shed abroad [compare Ecclus 43:17c], but verb not wholly suitable; Lag Gr proposes תַּטִּיף , yet this also questionable. Hoph`al Perfect 3masculine singular הוּנַף , be waved , Exod 29:27 (P), passive of Hiph`il 4.
